bounties.title: Vaultline Security Audit Grants for Colosseum Projects: Up to 4,000 USDC Each
bounties.description:
About Vaultline Security
Vaultline Security works to make Web3 safer. We believe strong security is essential for the ecosystem to grow and for builders and users to trust decentralized technology.
The Opportunity
We're offering audit grants to 10 Solana projects from the Colosseum Hackathon. Each selected team will receive a Vaultline security audit, either fully covered or at a significant discount, to strengthen their security before launch or scale.
What the Grant Covers
-
Each grant is worth up to 4,000 USDC in audit services, applied directly to a Vaultline audit. It is not paid out as cash.
-
Solana programs (Anchor or native) are in scope.
-
There's no fixed size limit. Vaultline will review each codebase and provide a full quote based on its complexity and lines of code. If the quote is within the grant amount, the audit is fully covered. If it's higher, the grant is applied as a discount.
Who Should Apply
Solana projects that took part in the Colosseum Hackathon and meet these conditions:
-
The codebase is feature-complete or close to it, so audit scope won't change significantly.
-
The code is in a repository Vaultline can access.
-
The team can respond to findings and implement fixes after the audit.
-
The team is prepared to cover any remaining cost if their quote exceeds the grant amount.
What to Submit
Answer the application question with:
-
Project name, short description, and Colosseum submission link
-
Repository link and the specific programs to be audited
-
Approximate lines of code (required, so we can quote accurately)
-
Current stage (devnet, testnet, or mainnet), plus any user or TVL figures
-
1-2 paragraphs on why an audit matters for your project right now
-
Team contact details
Selection Criteria
-
Project potential: How impactful and innovative is the project within the Solana ecosystem?
-
Audit need: How much do user funds or trust depend on the code being secure?
-
Readiness: Is the codebase mature and stable enough for a meaningful audit?
Rewards
10 audit grants, each worth up to 4,000 USDC in Vaultline audit services. Final grant value is based on each project's custom quote.
Timeline
-
Applications close: October 31, 2026
-
Selected projects announced: November 2, 2026
Announcement
Vaultline will announce the selected projects on Superteam Earn, Twitter, and LinkedIn. By applying, selected teams agree to be named in the announcement and to share the post from their own accounts.

bounties.title: Redesign Your Favourite App on Solana
bounties.description:
About the Bounty
With Figma Config happening in Bengaluru and Solana Summit India coming up, we're inviting all designers to an Open Design Bounty, built around one simple idea — making a Solana app, or a few (or even one) product interactions better than they are today.
This challenge is built around design and product thinking, utility, and of course, *taste*.
Your Mission
Redesign an app, or 1-5 features or interactions in a Solana app, and improve it to the best of your thinking. Focus on UX pain points, visual identity, thoughtfulness, and show us how your redesign makes the experience better for users.
Winners and strong submissions automatically qualify for Solana Summit India on 2nd November.
Evaluation Criteria
In addition to the criteria shared above, our judges will use the following criteria to judge your submissions:
-
Does your redesign solve a real user problem or make an existing interaction easier?
-
Did you clearly explain your design choices and show how they improve on the current experience?
-
Is your design visually cohesive, polished, and thoughtful in its details?
-
Would someone new to the app find your redesigned experience intuitive and easy to use?
Submission Requirements
-
Figma file with before/after screens for each feature
-
Mobile and desktop variations
-
A short write-up explaining the problems and your design decisions
Brownie points for a live link to your redesign.
Some Inspiration:
-
Trading Chart UX by Irfan
-
Promo Cards Interaction in Fuse
-
Multi Action button in Fuse
About Superteam India
Superteam India is the Indian chapter of Superteam, a curated community of founders, builders, designers, and operators in the Solana ecosystem. Alongside developers, we're building a strong home for designers: help them connecting with Solana projects that need great design, and spotlighting their work across the ecosystem.
Terms
Participation in this bounty is entirely voluntary. Bounties are a way to learn and dabble in opportunities to build in web3. These are neither full time jobs nor project based engagement. Please be advised that the sponsors will not have time for individualized feedback due to the number of entries we receive.

bounties.title: Launch & Trade on Daejin: Write a Twitter Thread and Create a Market
bounties.description:
About Daejin
Daejin is a creator-owned prediction market network built on Solana and part of the Superteam ecosystem.
-
Launch a market on any real-world outcome — crypto prices, sports, culture.
-
Take a position on Yes or No — prices move in real time with the crowd's conviction.
-
Trust the result — every market resolves with published, evidence-based proof, verifiable on-chain.
Featured markets for this bounty: https://www.daejin.xyz/prediction
Your Mission
Try Daejin from both sides — take a position and launch your own market — then write a Twitter thread that gets people talking about it and makes someone brand-new to prediction markets want to try it.
Your cost: $5. Creating a market is free. Your position stays yours: if your call is right, you earn from the market on top of any bounty prize.
Step by Step
-
Connect your Solana wallet at daejin.xyz.
-
Take a position (min. $5) in one of the featured markets. Take a screenshot and note why you picked Yes or No.
-
Create your own market (free): a clear question, a defined proof source, and a resolution date. Take a screenshot. You can't take a position in your own market.
-
Optional, earns bonus points: seed your market with liquidity (any amount) and screenshot the deposit.
-
Write your thread. It should cover:
-
what Daejin is, in plain language;
-
how a shared-pool market works: how prices form and how winners split the pool;
-
your position and the reasoning or data behind it;
-
your market and why you designed it that way;
-
your screenshots from steps 2–4.
-
Tag @Daejinxyz and @Superteam, then publish.
-
Submit your thread link on Earn, plus the link to your market. Your wallet address is collected with the submission, so don't post it in the thread.
Eligibility
A thread is judged only if it meets all of these:
-
a position of at least $5 in a featured market (or another creator's market);
-
your own market created on Daejin;
-
screenshots of both in the thread;
-
@Daejinxyz and @Superteam tagged;
-
the thread explains how Daejin works: threads that only post screenshots or a link are not judged;
-
original content published after this listing went live, and kept public until winners are announced.
Evaluation Criteria
Every eligible thread is scored out of 100. Reach and engagement are measured at the submission deadline.
Reach & Engagement: 30 pts
-
Total reach (15 pts): views, likes, reposts, quote posts, and replies on your thread.
-
Engagement rate (15 pts): interactions relative to your follower count, so smaller accounts with a highly engaged audience can compete with big ones.
Content Quality: 50 pts
-
Clarity (25 pts): does a newcomer understand how prices form and how payouts work?
-
Hands-on depth (25 pts): a real thesis behind your position, and a well-designed market (clear question, proof source, timeframe). Adding liquidity to your market earns bonus points.
Writing & Visuals: 20 pts
-
Easy and fun to read, no heavy jargon, clean screenshots.
Disqualification: botted views, paid engagement, engagement pods, or giveaway-style "like & RT to win" posts. We check account and engagement quality before announcing winners.
We never judge on the outcome of any market or on the size of your position or liquidity. If two threads tie, the one with higher Reach & Engagement wins.

bounties.title: Inside the Block: How Solana Validators Order Transactions
bounties.description:
About Superteam Ukraine
Superteam Ukraine is part of the Superteam network. We're focused on supporting the Solana ecosystem and helping talented individuals connect with exciting opportunities.
Mission
Investigate and document how Solana validators order transactions within a block, specifically focusing on validators running different client software or forks.
About
he order of transactions inside a block is decided by the leader’s scheduler. In the open-source Agave code the rule is visible; how the forks that hold most of the stake behave is not publicly documented. This bounty is a measurement project: send real transactions into the leader windows of specific validators and show, from the blocks, what rule they landed by.
Scope Detail
-
The Question: For each validator you pick: by what rule does it order transactions in its block - what exactly decides which transaction lands earlier and which later; how strictly that rule holds; and whether there is a rule at all.
-
Network: All measurements must be conducted on Solana Mainnet.
-
Validators: Analyze at least 6 validators, ensuring they span a minimum of 3 distinct client software or fork versions (identifiable by version string or validators.app data at the time of measurement).
-
Fee Spend: Your code must enforce a fee spend limit. The entire measurement process should fit within approximately 0.05 SOL.
-
Jito Validators: Validators running Jito-Solana are in scope for analysis, but Jito bundles and tips (a separate mechanism from the leader's scheduler) are not.
-
Transaction Evidence: While other transactions in the block can provide supplementary data, your primary evidence must be derived from transactions you send yourself.
-
Experiment Design: You have full control over the experiment's design, including the type and number of transactions, how they are sent, how leader windows are detected, and how the experiment is repeated.
-
Considerations: Leader schedule and leader types, the path of a transaction from your backend to the node that executes it (and everything in between), the interaction of your own transactions with each other, competition inside the block, send order, noise versus rule - the README must show how your design handles each of these, or why it deliberately does not.
-
Alpenglow Upgrade: October 21 - the Alpenglow upgrade, take all measurements either before it or after it, do not mix.
One possible development path. Not required, but this way you do not pay for development:
- localnet (solana-test-validator) - block parsing, pipeline tests;
- devnet - an end-to-end run with real sending, for free;
- mainnet dry-run - real leader schedule and windows, transactions are built but not sent; this is where you see whether you make it into the window;
- mainnet live - with the spend cap.
The measurements themselves are mainnet only: devnet has one client and empty blocks, there is nothing to measure.
Submission Requirements
-
Repository: submit a link to your code repository (any language is acceptable).
-
Reproducibility: the project must be fully reproducible with one command, Docker Compose expected.
-
Keys: keys only via volume/env, never in the repo.
-
Execution: dry-run by default, real sending only behind an explicit flag with a spend cap.
-
Raw Data: include all raw data, including transaction signatures and slot numbers, to allow judges to verify claims via getBlock calls.
-
README: why this design, how it handles the points under “what you will have to account for”, and what it does NOT separate.
-
Report: report with the date of every measurement and a “what went wrong” section.
Judging Criteria
-
Design Validity: 35% - does the experiment measure what it claims, and are the points under “what you will have to account for”.
-
Verifiability and Reproducibility: 25% - The ease with which judges can verify claims using raw data and reproduce the experiment.
-
Analysis Quality: 25% - The depth and quality of the analysis, including honesty about noise, limitations, and null results ("No rule / it’s noise" is a valid conclusion if supported).
-
Engineering: 15% - The quality of the engineering, specifically regarding the dry-run functionality, spend cap implementation, logging, and containerization.
Reward Structure
-
1st Place: 800
-
2nd Place: 600
-
3nd Place: 500
-
4nd Place: 300
-
4nd Place: 300

bounties.title: Show us how you use MozaikPay
bounties.description:
What we're building
MozaikPay is a payment app for digital dollars, money that keeps its value in US dollars and moves to anyone, instantly and for free.
People in Argentina, Chile and Colombia use it to add money from their bank, keep it in dollars, and send it to whoever they want. Sending to another MozaikPay user is free. If the other person isn't on MozaikPay yet, you send them a payment link and they claim it once they install the app. When you want your pesos back, you cash out to your bank, and you see the fee before you confirm, not after.
It's also self-custodial, which in plain words means the money in your wallet is yours.
What we're looking for
A 30 to 60 second video in Spanish, on TikTok or Instagram Reels, about a real money problem you (or someone close to you) actually deal with, and how MozaikPay fits into it.
Please don't make us an ad. Make the video you'd send a friend who asked "wait, how do you do that?"
If you need a starting point, these are the ones we hear about most:
-
Your salary lands in pesos and you move part of it into dollars before it loses value.
-
You owe a friend money, they don't have MozaikPay, so you send them a link and they claim it.
-
You live in Chile, your mom lives in Colombia, and she gets the dollars you send her the same minute.
A note on wording
We never say crypto, blockchain or token in the app. In the app you just see digital dollars.
Please don't give investment advice or promise returns, there aren't any, and don't compare our fees with other apps.
Submission requirements
Every point below is required. If your submission misses even one, it can't win a prize, no matter how good the video is.
The video
-
30 to 60 seconds long.
-
In Spanish.
-
Shows your real MozaikPay account on screen.
-
Marked as sponsored, with #publicidad or the platform's paid partnership toggle.
-
No investment advice and no promised returns.
-
No fee comparisons with other apps.
-
Doesn't say crypto, blockchain or token.
Where it's posted
-
On your own account, as a TikTok or an Instagram Reel (public profile).
-
Posted after this listing went live.
-
Still up when we pick the winners.
-
More than half of that account's audience is in Chile and Colombia combined.
We'd also like you to keep the video up for at least 30 days after you post it. We can't check that before the bounty ends, so it's not a prize requirement. We do look at it when we pick creators for paid work later.
What to submit
-
The link to your video.
-
A screenshot of your audience countries from your TikTok or Instagram analytics.
-
Your MozaikPay username, so we can match it to the account in the video.
Rewards
-
1st place, 150 USDC
-
2nd place, 100 USDC
-
3rd place, 50 USDC
-
4 more spots, 50 USDC each
If your video does well, we'll want to work with you again, and we'll pay for it.
Resources

What is MozaikPay? (Spanish)
-
Set up your account (Spanish)
-
Create and share a payment link (Spanish)

Download on iOS
-

bounties.title: MultiHopper Build & Route Challenge | Up to $50,000 + Revenue Share
bounties.description:
Build something that moves money.
Build a useful Solana product with MultiHopper, bring it real users, and turn onchain activity into a business. Earn ongoing integration revenue and compete for a total prize pool that grows from $5,000 to $50,000.
There is $5,000 guaranteed for the winners with more based on transaction volume success.
Why transaction volume as a goal? Because we want to help people create a business and give them a head start with MultiHopper rather than build solutions that go nowhere. And then we want to support them in growing.
That means building a product, marketing it, and growing something that you get to keep, which makes money while you sleep.
Explore the campaign and interactive earnings calculator →
Your product. Your volume. Your upside.
Customers pay a 0.5% percentage fee on full-rate transfers. Half goes to you: 0.25% of full-fee volume, or $2,500 for every $1 million routed. MultiHopper uses its own 0.25% share to fund the competition pool. Per-hop fees are excluded.
Integration revenue is separate from the prize and does not depend on winning. Partner onboarding and agreed revenue-sharing terms apply.
A prize pool that grows with adoption
-
NOTE: If your product does not generate at least $100,000 of transaction volume, you will not qualify.
-
ONLY PRODUCTION VOLUME IS COUNTED. Devnet volume does not.
-
Every additional $400,000 unlocks another $1,000.
-
$4 million funds $10,000; $8 million funds $20,000.
-
$11 million funds a $27,000 pool from $27,500 retained fees.
-
$20 million aggregated across every project that enters unlocks the maximum $50,000 pool.
These are cumulative prize pools, awarded once after verification. The top three eligible products share the funded pool in proportion to their qualifying transaction volume.
Your prize = total funded pool × your qualifying volume ÷ combined qualifying volume of the top three. For example, 40% of the winners’ volume earns 40% of the pool, in addition to integration revenue. This is a competition top-up, not a guaranteed personal 1:1 match.
Draft terms: the initial $5,000 award is conditional on reaching $2 million aggregate qualifying volume. Dates and Earn’s support for variable, volume-proportional awards must be confirmed before publication. Any fixed prize fields in this draft are placeholders; the proportional formula above is the intended allocation.
What could you build?
-
Privacy-first token sends: a wallet, bot or SDK for discreet SOL and supported-token transfers with configurable routing and timing.
-
Launch distribution and unbundling: allocation management, routed Multi-Send payouts and recipient tools for launches.
-
Migration tools: distribute replacement tokens with reconciliation, status tracking and safe retries.
-
Swaps with hooks: combine an external Solana swap integration with MultiHopper routes and signed completion webhooks.
-
AI agent treasuries: budgets, approval rules, service payments and programmable capital movement.
-
Stablecoin payments: supplier payments, invoices, checkout, payroll and marketplace payouts.
-
OTC settlement: quote-to-delivery tools with routed settlement and receipts.
-
Treasury automation: operational wallet funding, distribution schedules and event-driven workflows.
-
Agent-to-agent commerce: paid research, compute and task marketplaces.
-
Creator payouts: royalties, affiliate earnings and contributor distributions.
And of course: you could launch a token for your project with any number of launchpads to help speed your process, engineering, adoption and transaction volume.
Use the standard API, supported programmable route parameters or Multi-Send as your product needs. You can use random or custom routing APIs, as well as agentic.
Your application supplies swaps, approval policies and business logic. Build against current Solana deployment capabilities. Routing reduces simple linkage; it does not erase public-chain history or guarantee anonymity. Funds are not pooled or commingled.
Build with a recognized team
MultiHopper won third place in the Visa track at Superteam Germany’s Solana Colosseum event in Berlin.
MultiHopper is an official TRM Labs partner, with compliance controls built into the smart contract and TRM-powered screening integrated into the routing workflow. Every product you build with us will have TRM Labs compliance and screening built directly into your product by default at the smart contract level. That’s something you and your clients can rely on.
Watch Alex pitch MultiHopper
Co-founder and CBO Alex Kujavsky shares the vision and demonstrates Custom Routing.
Watch the full pitch and demo →
Our team: João (JRA), COO and co-founder, is a member of Superteam Germany. Alex Kujavsky, CBO and co-founder, is a member of Superteam Canada.
Mentorship and introductions
Winning teams are eligible for mentorship from Enigma, founder of MultiHopper and GP of EnigmaFund. He has mentored more than 40 teams, with experience across L1 ecosystems and projects including Movement, Toshi, Anyone Protocol and Perle.
-
Product, positioning and business-model guidance.
-
Fundraising strategy and investor readiness.
-
Relevant introductions within our fundraising network.
-
Connections to founders, partners and potential customers.
Support is tailored to each winning team. Introductions depend on fit and availability; funding is not guaranteed. Referenced projects describe Enigma’s experience, not campaign sponsorship.
Eligibility and judging
-
Ship a working Solana product integrating MultiHopper and complete production onboarding.
-
Generate at least $100,000 qualifying volume per product during the common measurement window.
-
Pass functionality, security and genuine-usage review.
-
Rank by verified, fee-adjusted transaction volume. Product quality and repeat usage break ties.
Qualifying volume is collected MultiHopper percentage fees divided by 0.0025. Discounted transfers count proportionally. Count principal once: hops and Multi-Send recipients never multiply volume. Exclude failed, refunded, free, devnet, circular and prize-farming activity. Legitimate treasury movements must have a verifiable business purpose. Fewer than three eligible teams share the pool proportionally; no eligible teams means no awards.
While you can contact the team for assistance in the MultiHopper Builder community all entries must be made on Superteam Earn. We will not consider any other entries
What to submit
-
Live product URL and a short demo video.
-
Description of the user problem and your MultiHopper integration.
-
Repository or review access and technical documentation.
-
Registered integration identifier and verifiable transaction evidence.
-
Qualifying-volume summary, genuine customer/use-case evidence and contact details.
-
All entries MUST be submitted on Superteam Earn.
-
Provide traction metrics and growth stats
Provide sensitive customer evidence privately to the review team.
Resources
-
Campaign, earnings calculator, team and pitch video
-
Join the MultiHopper Builder Community
-
Developer quickstart
-
API documentation
-
API access and onboarding
-
Contact Enigma
Bring the idea. Build something useful. Make the next move.
